title: D2P Fit Map
description: Derived fit map of one drape (design decision ADR-029 §3 'FitMap', §6): strain, clearance and a contact pressure approximation per landmark-defined body zone and optionally per vertex. It is always labelled a model estimate with its solver profile and material status, and never replaces a fitting (ADR-011 §7, FIT-004). Findings derived from a personal-derived fit map are restricted (D2P-SEM-052, FMP-002).

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

createdAt.description: When the document was produced (UTC). Excluded from the resultDigest.

sceneSnapshotRef.description: The drape scene (mode 'physical-simulation') the map is computed on; 'digest' is its sceneDigest.

bodyModelRef.description: The body model of that scene; 'digest' is its resultDigest.

avatarProfile.description: Avatar profile whose zones the map uses.

materialStatus.description: 'provisional' when any material physics profile of the drape is provisional, else 'frozen'. Shown with the map.

estimate.description: Always 'model-estimate': a fit map is a model estimate, never a fit promise, and is never combined with analytical ease results (design decision ADR-029 §6, FIT-004, FMP-003).

zones.description: Zone summaries, one per zone of the avatar profile, sorted by zone (FMP-001).

vertexFields.description: Optional per-vertex values, one entry per draped panel, sorted by panelInstanceId; each array has one value per vertex of that panel's draped mesh (D2P-SEM-129).

personalDerived.description: True when the document derives from a body measurement profile classified 'personal' or 'sensitive-personal' (directly or through a pinned body model or scene). Such a document is geometry or data derived from personal data and is served only under the export rules of that profile; a document that derives from such a profile without stating true is reported as D2P-SEM-050. Absent means false.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (d2p-digest-v1, excluding contentDigest).

fitZone.title: Fit zone
fitZone.description: Summary of one body zone. Strain is dimensionless (draped edge length / rest edge length − 1); clearance is the signed distance from the body surface to the cloth in mm (negative inside the body); the contact pressure index approximates contact pressure as the mean positive strain of the zone's cloth vertices in contact with the body (0 when none).

zone.description: Body zone of the avatar profile.

landmarkIds.description: The zone's landmarks, as defined by the avatar profile.

panelInstanceIds.description: Panel instances with cloth vertices in the zone (sorted, unique).

panelFitField.title: Panel fit field
panelFitField.description: Per-vertex values of one draped panel.
